<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // universal for mega--split / mega--news / mega--topics
        const splitPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.mega--split, .mega--news, .mega--topics');

        splitPanels.forEach(function(panel) {
            const tabs = panel.querySelectorAll('.news-rail__link');
            const sections = panel.querySelectorAll('.news-panel');
            const wrapper = panel.querySelector('.news-panels');

            if (!tabs.length) return;

            const isTopicsPanel = panel.classList.contains('mega--topics');

            function isMobileTopics() {
                return isTopicsPanel && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 780px)').matches;
            }

            function setWrapperHeight() {
                if (!wrapper || !sections.length) return;

                if (isMobileTopics()) {
                    wrapper.style.minHeight = '';
                    return;
                }

                let maxH = 0;
                sections.forEach(sec => {
                    const wasHidden = sec.hasAttribute('hidden') || sec.style.display === 'none';
                    if (wasHidden) {
                        sec.removeAttribute('hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                    const h = sec.offsetHeight;
                    if (h > maxH) maxH = h;
                    if (wasHidden && !sec.classList.contains('is-active')) {
                        sec.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
                if (maxH) wrapper.style.minHeight = maxH + 'px';
            }

            function activate(targetId, btn) {
                if (!sections.length) return;
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    const active = t === btn;
                    t.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
                    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
                });
                sections.forEach(sec => {
                    const match = sec.id === targetId;
                    sec.classList.toggle('is-active', match);
                    if (match) {
                        sec.removeAttribute('hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'block';
                    } else {
                        sec.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
            }

            tabs.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    const target = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const href = this.getAttribute('data-href');

                    // mobile topics: redirect
                    if (isMobileTopics()) {
                        if (href && href !== '#') {
                            window.location.href = href;
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    // normal tabs
                    if (target) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        activate(target, this);
                    }
                });

                btn.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                    const target = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const href = this.getAttribute('data-href');

                    if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {

                        if (isMobileTopics()) {
                            if (href && href !== '#') {
                                window.location.href = href;
                            }
                            return;
                        }

                        if (target) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            activate(target, this);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });

            setWrapperHeight();

            let resizeTimer;
            window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
                resizeTimer = setTimeout(setWrapperHeight, 150);
            });
        });
    });

<p><strong><a href="https://elistair.com/">Elistair’s</a> automated <a href="https://elistair.com/solutions/tethered-dronebox-khronos/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Khronos Tethered DroneBox</a> was utilized in ORION 2026, France’s large-scale joint military exercise.</strong></p>



<p>Running from February to April 2026, the exercise mobilized up to 12,500 military personnel across the country in a high-intensity, multi-domain scenario involving land, sea, air, space, cyber, and electromagnetic domains. Over 1,200 drones of various types were deployed throughout the operation.</p>



<p>Elistair, a designer and manufacturer of tethered drones for security applications, participated in Phase O4, which ran from April 7 to 30. This followed the company’s initial contribution during Phase O2 in February, which demonstrated France’s ability to fully integrate into a NATO command structure for collective defense scenarios.</p>

</div>


<p>During the final week of April, forces conducted offensive exploitation operations, river crossings, the retaking of key positions, and live-fire exercises. Within this demanding environment, the Khronos platform addresses one of the most pressing challenges in modern high-intensity conflict.</p>



<p>The system provides persistent, continuous aerial surveillance from fixed or mobile platforms without relying on GNSS or radio frequency infrastructure. By eliminating the dependency on battery-limited free-flying drones, the technology ensures that military personnel can maintain real-time situational awareness in contested and GNSS-denied environments.</p>

Elistair’s automated Khronos Tethered DroneBox was utilized in ORION 2026, France’s large-scale joint military exercise.

Running from February to April 2026, the exercise mobilized up to 12,500 military personnel across the country in a high-intensity, multi-domain scenario involving land, sea, air, space, cyber, and electromagnetic domains. Over 1,200 drones of various types were deployed throughout the operation.

Elistair, a designer and manufacturer of tethered drones for security applications, participated in Phase O4, which ran from April 7 to 30. This followed the company’s initial contribution during Phase O2 in February, which demonstrated France’s ability to fully integrate into a NATO command structure for collective defense scenarios.

During the final week of April, forces conducted offensive exploitation operations, river crossings, the retaking of key positions, and live-fire exercises. Within this demanding environment, the Khronos platform addresses one of the most pressing challenges in modern high-intensity conflict.

The system provides persistent, continuous aerial surveillance from fixed or mobile platforms without relying on GNSS or radio frequency infrastructure. By eliminating the dependency on battery-limited free-flying drones, the technology ensures that military personnel can maintain real-time situational awareness in contested and GNSS-denied environments.
